title: Evaluate and adopt compatible same-model browser precision
description: Purpose: resolve measured q8 incompatibility without changing CLAP embedding space, ground model, inference location or numerical gates. Supervisor authorizes pinned same-export fp32 WASM as candidate (larger static download). Own encoder manifest/runtime, browser evaluator and related tests only. Excludes app search, backend, cloud inference, board/git/release writes. Tests first: exact manifest fp32/text_model.onnx, same512 normalization/progress/cancel/cache contracts, measured missing/failure gates. Supervisor captures six real browser vectors against pinned Python and48 audio candidates and desktop warm timing, reruns tests/build. Missing mobile/listening remains explicit, never fabricated. Handoff: file inventory/red-green/evidence/blockers. No commit/push/close.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Supervisor real-browser evidence: pinned fp32 WASM text-only export, six fixed prompts,48 pinned Python audio references. Every cosine >=0.999999999997; every top20 retention1.0;20 cache-bypassed warm encodes desktop p95=58.819999993ms. Isolation headers verified; no browser errors.19 unit tests/build/contract check passed. Raw artifact /tmp/apricity-semantic-delivery.53NDAo/browser-fp32-desktop.json. Adopt fp32 same-model for supervised desktop development, static download ~502MB rather than original127MB q8 default. No mobile/listening/cloud gate claimed. Preserve q8 failure artifact; update accepted evidence bindings and design before landing.
